integrity: Exhaustive exact-integer calculation of all 256 tree-normalized signings with an independent Krawtchouk-transform check of each histogram. Known seven signed-Heawood switching-isomorphism classes and frustration values credited to Sivaraman (2012); no independent review claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact normalized moments of the zero-field signed Ising Hamiltonian on the fixed fourteen-vertex Heawood graph. No claim for varying graph sizes, transverse fields, noisy estimators, or external experimental validation.
title: Sharp eighth-moment frustration threshold for the signed Heawood Ising model
